output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[target], which can overflow if mintedAmount is large.
The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The mintedAmount is added to totalSupply, which can overflow if mintedAmount is large.
The transfer function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], which can be exploited to prevent transfers.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from], which can overflow if balanceOf[_from] is small and _value is large.
